reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 141 seats for the Moorland rollout at Marrow Fieldworks.

I checked #central-team and every shared file I can see (none are under accounts/, so there are no contracts or CRM records). None of them give a seat count for that rollout. I told her I'm treating 141 as unverified and won't pass it on as a fact. I also offered to check it if someone points me to a contract, order form or CRM record that has the count.
